# gws recipe: Share event materials

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the share-event-materials recipe: the cross-service flow « share the meeting docs with everyone » — get the event's attendees via the Calendar API, then grant each attendee file permissions on Drive, in 3 steps. Distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-batch-invite-to-event` in this lot (which manages attendees, not files): this one manages files for existing attendees. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-drive` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
